card.name: The word Effect before "of [drug]"
card.fires_on: The word effect or effects right before "of" and a drug name, mostly in section headings and table titles about drug interactions. Also fires on lowercase "effect of X" in running text.

modes.label: Interaction headings
modes.description: Capitalized Effect(s) starting a heading or table title such as "Effect of X on Other Drugs".

modes.label: Running-text effect of a drug
modes.description: Lowercase effect in a sentence, followed by "of" and a drug name.

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict effect-type words and "on", as in "effect of X on Y".
card.plain: It marks the word "effect" that begins a drug-interaction heading or phrase like "effect of this drug on that one".
